## 04400a6b6096

**Reproduced defect — exact motif count can be silently underfilled.** The audited generator SHA-256 is `48809ce6334ad7ad76ddc535dae3fbffb77a96af2dfeb06d2a978e7a575da361`. With seed `1`, sample index `0`, and exact overrides `grid_h=7`, `grid_w=7`, `motif_count=4`, `texture=plain`, the greedy placement loop returns only two complete X motifs. It exhausts 300 random attempts for later colors without raising or retrying the layout. `self_check` still returns `[]` because it only requires at least one motif, so the advertised exact control is observably violated on a validator-lawful input.

Evidence: `checks/audit/04400a6b6096/reproduce_motif_count.py`, `reproduction.log`, `input_metadata.json`, and `input.json`. `checks/audit/04400a6b6096/racket.json` confirms the input executes under canonical rule hash `d52dd582b9a1` with a valid output. The isolated audit preset also reports no tests and no semantic contract in `checks/audit/04400a6b6096-combined/checks/04400a6b6096_audit_summary.json`. I left the audited source unchanged.

A repair should use a constructive/backtracking placement or reject incompatible exact requests, then make `self_check(meta=...)` verify the requested motif count. A regression should pin this seed and also sweep the smallest supported grids at the maximum advertised count.
